title: ContainerExecPost
description: ContainerExecPost represents an container execution request

command.description: Command inside the container to execute

environment.description: Environment to setup when the command is executed.

height.description: Height of the terminal. Only required when `interactive` is set to `true`.

interactive.description: Whether the command is executed interactively or not

width.description: Width of the terminal. Only required when `interactive` is set to `true`.
